name: Nordhausen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the city arms of Nordhausen (a black eagle on yellow with helmet and crest).
history: Municipal flag of Nordhausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Nordhausen arms — black eagle on yellow with helmet and crest
